messages:
Diego (Sales): Heads-up — prospect requests a 6-week EU-only pilot with hard region lock to a single EU data center + BYOK. They want: EU-only subprocessor list, audit-log residency, emergency-failover process, and a single-line procurement estimate. Can we commit? :thinking:
Priya (Presales): I can own the technical SOW. Clarify: hard lock implies Dedicated or Private only; Hosted offers affinity not hard lock. Also confirm BYOK HSM requirements (keys never leave EU).
Ravi (Infra): Confirmed: Dedicated/Private support hard region pin. BYOK supported via VaultCorp EU HSM or AWS KMS with customer CMKs in eu-central-1; we can ensure key material doesn't leave region for the POC.
Nora (Security): Audit logs default to ManagedLog EU (eu-central-1). If customer needs their own log bucket we can forward logs to their S3. We'll add deletion SLA and proof-of-deletion language in SOW.
Hana (Ops): For peering: we can provision NL and DE POPs and a tenant CNAME. Need customer ASN and TLS termination preference. Ops estimate: ~10h initial setup + 4h/week support during POC. I'll provide CNAME template and RFC.
Diego (Sales): Procurement wants a one-line price. Ops/legal can we give a single-line ballpark (monthly + one-time)?
Hana (Ops): Ballpark one-line: "EU-only POC (Dedicated reservation, region lock, BYOK) — est. $28,500/month + $9,500 one-time integration." Includes reserved GPUs, +20% regional premium, BYOK engineering and peering.
Priya (Presales): Test plan snippet for SOW: workload 10M tokens/mo, p95 latency target <120ms from NL POP, failover disabled for POC. Smoke test curl: ```curl -X POST https://eu-pilot.redwood.example/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"latency test"}]}'```
Nora (Security): Security questionnaire items: physical HSM location, in-transit encryption endpoints, subprocessors with metadata access, and whether US-based support may access systems. We'll state support is role-based and region-scoped; support sessions logged and require customer approval for key ops.
Ravi (Infra): EU-only subprocessor list for POC: AWS (eu-central-1), EdgeNet EU (NL/DE POPs), VaultCorp EU (HSM), ManagedLog EU (eu-central-1), PacketRelay EU (caching). I'll link attestation docs in the SOW.
Diego (Sales): Legal: must-have clause re: "no cross-border egress" during POC and emergency fallback?
legal-bot: Automated note: include DPA + EU SCCs link. Add clause: "No cross-border egress during POC except with Customer written approval for named emergencies; all support sessions logged."
Nora (Security): For BYOK, support will never request key material. Any grant/attach operations are performed with customer consent and can be audited.
Hana (Ops): I'll produce a one-page runbook (CNAME template, ASN ranges, cert chain expectations, DNS checklist). ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Presales): I'll assemble the tech appendix, test plan, and pasteable SOW blurb: "Redwood will provision a Dedicated EU-only tenancy in eu-central-1 for the POC. No cross-border egress will occur. Customer BYOK will be used and key material will remain in EU HSM. Support access will be region-scoped and logged."
Diego (Sales): Thanks — I'll send the provisional quote tomorrow and follow up with the security questionnaire answers in a separate thread.
